Everything in this folder has been tested by someone, somewhere.

character_line_en: Do not oversell it. People can tell when a thing is held together with tape.
player_reply_en: I will not promise more than it does.

A good system is the one nobody notices. Aim for that.
Ask them what they already have before offering them something new.
If it breaks, we fix it. I carry the tools.
I know which page of this the ministry will actually read. It is marked.
player_reply_en: Then that is the page I use.

player_reply_en: Then page four had better be good.

character_line_en: The clerks will check the footnotes. I made sure they hold.
If they ask for the form number, it is on the back of the folder.
Procedure is a kind of politeness. Follow it and they listen.
I know who signs off on this. I would not antagonize them.
player_reply_en: Noted. I will keep it civil.

character_line_en: The binder has a tab for each likely question. Use the tabs.
Say it plainly and cite the article. Clerks remember articles.
There is one officer who reads everything. Write for that officer.
I filed the papers in the order they will be asked about.
Official language is a shield. Use a little, not a lot.
If they stall, ask which unit owns the decision. That ends most stalls.
player_reply_en: Which unit owns it. Good question.

character_line_en: I looked at the money behind the plan. It is thinner than it should be.
player_reply_en: Then I will not lean on them.

character_line_en: I have seen a plan like this fail quietly. Watch the margins.
Ask what happens if the numbers come in ten percent worse.
I raised a warning once and it cost me my job. I would raise this one again.
player_reply_en: I am glad you speak up.

character_line_en: If something looks too safe, find out who is covering the risk.
Never promise a figure you cannot show a cushion for.
The tables are clean. The assumptions under them are not.
player_reply_en: Then I will question the assumptions.

character_line_en: I put the weak point on the second page, where you will see it.
player_reply_en: Better I see it than they do.

character_line_en: Be honest about what we do not know. It reads as strength.
A cautious answer lasts longer than a bold one.
player_reply_en: Then I will be cautious where it counts.

character_line_en: The regulators always ask the same three things. I wrote them down.
player_reply_en: Three questions. I will be ready.

character_line_en: If they push you on cost, give the range, not the single number.

player_reply_en: That is a rare thing to hear.

character_line_en: I found three sentences that could be quoted against you. They are gone.
player_reply_en: Gone, and I never saw them.

character_line_en: Read it aloud once. If you stumble, we change the line.
I have cleared out copies of a bad draft before. Nobody noticed.
player_reply_en: Then I will not start worrying now.

character_line_en: The risky phrase is on page two. Skip it or soften it.
If you are unsure how a word will sound, drop it.
Every number here is checked against the final version. Not the draft.
I would rather catch a mistake at midnight than read it in the morning papers.
The line they will want to repeat is not the one you want. I planned for it.
player_reply_en: Then I will steer toward mine.

character_line_en: One careless adjective can undo a good speech. Choose yours.
I marked the lines that are safe to repeat. Repeat those.
If you slip, correct it at once and without drama.
Both sides will say no at first. Let them finish before you speak.
I once got two enemies to share a lunch table. Start with something small.
Find the one thing they agree on and say it first.
Nobody changes their mind while they are being shouted at.
The briefing lists what each side wants. Read the overlap.
If the room is tense, ask a question you already know they can answer.
Offer them a way to say yes without losing face.
player_reply_en: A door they can walk through.

character_line_en: I wrote down what each side is afraid of. It matters more than what they ask for.
Wait one beat before you answer. It calms the room.
player_reply_en: One beat. I can do that.

character_line_en: Do not take a side too early. You can always take one later.
player_reply_en: Keep it open as long as I can.

character_line_en: Remember their names. People forgive a lot after you do.
A shared meal does more than a good argument. Keep that in mind.
Give them one picture they cannot forget. Words come after.
Show the hands, not the speech. People remember hands.
I once shot a photo essay that doubled an apprenticeship list. Details win.
player_reply_en: Then I will find the detail.

character_line_en: Stand where the light is good. It matters more than you think.
A calm face will be the photo on the front page. Keep it calm.
Tell a story with a beginning, a person and an ending.
player_reply_en: A person in the middle of it.

character_line_en: If they take your picture mid-sentence, finish the sentence smiling.
Pick one word to hold on to and let it echo.

character_line_en: Keep your hands visible. People trust what they can see.
player_reply_en: Hands where they can see them.

character_line_en: I chose the photos for the handout. They look like you.
player_reply_en: Then they are the ones I will use.

character_line_en: Craft takes time. Do not rush the answer.
I know how listeners think. They want a quote, not a lecture.
Half the gallery owes me favors. I will not spend them today.
Give them one sentence they can print whole. They will print it.
If a listener looks bored, you are being too careful.
Never say "no comment." Say what you can and stop.
player_reply_en: Say what I can, then stop.

Remember who asked the last question. They will ask the next.
player_reply_en: I will keep an eye on them.

Answer the question they should have asked. Then answer theirs.

Read it once without stopping. We fix the rhythm from there.
Use a short sentence after a long one. It lands harder.
Never apologize in the opening line. Earn the pause instead.
I marked where to breathe. Trust the marks.
A name said with respect carries a whole paragraph.
player_reply_en: Then I will say the names.

Say it three times in one speech. That is how it sticks.
A slogan is a promise in a hurry. Do not make one you cannot keep.
Short beats clever. Clever beats long. Long loses.
Pick a verb. Posters run on verbs.
I wrote six versions and chose the one that chanted best.
If a line makes you smile when you say it, keep it.
Never let the opposition finish your line for you.
A slogan only has to be right once, on the right day.
I put the key words in bold. Hit those.
Temples and shrines still call me first. Remember they call us, too.
Feed people first and talk later. It works in a crisis and in a debate.
A joint kitchen taught me that people will share a pot before they share an opinion.
Keep your tone warm. Cold words travel faster than warm ones.
Thank the volunteers by name. They will tell everyone.
If a temple group and a shrine group share a room, favor neither.
I wrote down what each community cares about. It is short.
A calm voice in a rough room is worth a dozen good points.
If someone is upset, listen to the whole complaint first.
Say what you will do this week, not this decade.
Be generous with credit. It costs nothing and returns a lot.
I keep tea on hand. It slows everyone down in a good way.

On the docks, people wanted help and a straight answer. Give both.
Use one word from their own trade. They will know you listened.
Working people rise before dawn. Do not keep them waiting.
On the boats, nobody trusted a promise without a number. Bring one.
Help only counts once it reaches the dock. Say how it gets there.
People respect someone who shows up cold and wet.
Word travels like harbor gossip. Whatever you say today is known by evening.
player_reply_en: Then I will say it carefully.

Do not pretend to know the tides. Ask whoever does.
On the boats, cold storage meant a better price. Always make the link clear.

Start small. A garden began with one bed and a few neighbors.
People believe what they can see growing. Show them something that grows.
The volunteers do the work and want the credit shared. Share it.
Ask who lives next to any project. Their opinion decides it.
Ward by ward is slower. It also lasts.
Bring a tool to the meeting, not a speech. It changes the mood.

player_reply_en: Then I will greet them well.

player_reply_en: Then I will not be surprised.

Win the quiet votes. They decide close races.

Learn who sits where. It tells you who matters to whom.
Never let an event end without thanking the host.

Forty shop owners joined because I asked each one in person.
A shop owner wants two things: less paperwork and a fair price.
Stop by in the morning. That is when they have time and tea.
At a shop, buy something. Owners talk more if you do.

player_reply_en: I will show up on slow days.

player_reply_en: Then I will not take it lightly.

player_reply_en: Then I will be sure first.

player_reply_en: Then I will vote in a way I can explain.

player_reply_en: I will aim for the second.

player_reply_en: Then I have a choice to make.

player_reply_en: Then I will read the fine print.

character_line_en: My party will weigh this on what it costs and who pays.

player_reply_en: Then I will cast it plainly.

Be able to explain every vote you cast tonight.
I read the whole file before coming. I hope you did too.

player_reply_en: Then I will try to earn it.

character_line_en: I would rather lose honestly than win by pretending.
player_reply_en: Then we have that in common.

character_line_en: Rules exist so we can disagree without chaos. I like them.
Speak plainly and I will listen plainly.
I will say what I think and you will say what you think. That is the job.
Let us start from the numbers we both accept, if there are any.
I would like to find common ground. I will also find the weak spot in your plan.
The figures are on my side today. I would hate to say so twice.
Farms are not spreadsheets. They are people up before dawn.
I am willing to be persuaded by anyone who has visited a field.
player_reply_en: Then let me tell you about one.

character_line_en: Bring me a number and a face, and I will pay attention to both.
Everything costs something. I only ask that you say what.
I am easy to work with, and hard to hurry.
A good budget tells the truth about its own limits.
Administration is dull until it fails. Then it is all anyone talks about.
player_reply_en: Then let us keep it dull.

character_line_en: I will ask the boring question, and I expect a real answer.
Show me who is responsible at each step.
I have heard every argument twice. Surprise me.
Governing is choosing, and choosing is never popular.
I respect anyone who comes prepared. I notice who does not.
I prefer a long discussion to a quick vote.
Let us go through it item by item, calmly.
If we disagree, I would like to know exactly where.
player_reply_en: Then let me show you the line.

character_line_en: Projects get built by people who finish things. Are you one?
I like a plan with dates on it. Do you have dates?
Be careful. I enjoy pointing out where a plan falls short.
I want to believe you. Give me a reason.
I have heard promises before, and I remember all of them.
player_reply_en: Then I will keep this one.

character_line_en: Some questions are better answered slowly. Think before you speak.
Every road and bridge in my district has a family's name on it.
player_reply_en: Then they deserve to be heard.

character_line_en: Tell me how this changes things for people I know.
player_reply_en: Let me tell you about them.

character_line_en: I care about the figures, but I care more about the faces.
I would rather settle this over tea than by shouting.
There is always another way to say it. Let me hear yours.
I am flexible on language. I am not flexible on safety.
I feel strongly about this. I will not hide it.
player_reply_en: I would not ask you to.

character_line_en: Not everything I say is the whole story. Be careful.
I know exactly where you are weakest. I may or may not use it.
I have presided over worse days than this one.
player_reply_en: I will not make it worse.

character_line_en: Everyone speaks. I only ask that they also listen.
I hold this chair for every member, including those who disagree with me.
player_reply_en: That is how it should be.

character_line_en: I would like us to leave this room agreeing on something.
Procedure is only as good as the people following it.
player_reply_en: Then let us follow it well.

character_line_en: I read your record. There is more to agree with than I expected.
Every harvest depends on a decision made in rooms like this.
player_reply_en: Then I will treat it seriously.

character_line_en: I answer to farmers first and to the Assembly second.
Bring me your best argument and your best manners.
The land does not vote, so I speak for it.
player_reply_en: Then I will listen on its behalf.

character_line_en: I would like to hear what you can offer, not only what you oppose.
Facts first, then feelings. I find the order helps.
I take integrity seriously, and I notice who does not.
A good answer and an honest answer are not always the same.
I will give you every chance to be straightforward.
I get attached to causes. Fair warning.
I will smile and still disagree. Do not mistake the first for the second.
Show me data, and I will pretend I was never worried.
I prefer evidence to opinion, and I will ask for it.
I have no patience for slogans.
Let us keep it honest and keep it short.
I grew up thinking about what grows and what does not.
I will listen as long as you are sincere.
A fair deal is one both sides can live with tomorrow.
Every figure I quote has a source. Expect to be asked for yours.
I will compromise on timing before I compromise on arithmetic.
Be precise. The ledger does not forgive vagueness.
I am happy to cooperate. Up to a point.
A friendly tone costs nothing, and it tells you nothing.
I always have another move in mind. Do you?
Other countries are watching how we argue. Mind your manners.
I will ask what this means for our neighbors.
Honest answers travel further than clever ones.
I work through the briefing line by line before I speak.
player_reply_en: Then I will be ready for it.

character_line_en: Treaties are only as good as the trust behind them.
player_reply_en: Then I will build that trust.

character_line_en: I would rather hear a hard truth than a soft promise.
I will be polite. I will also be difficult.
Defense is expensive and so is being wrong about it.
player_reply_en: Then let us get it right.

character_line_en: Make your case with numbers and I will look for the weak one.
I have seen many Assemblies. This one is no worse than the others.
A country is more than its budget. Remember that.
Speak to what we are, and not only to what we want.
player_reply_en: Then I will start with that.

character_line_en: I carry the voices of my district in here. They are loud.
I only want to be sure the people I represent are not forgotten.
You can disagree with me and still be welcome here.
I believe in saying what I mean, mostly.
Diplomacy is the art of saying hard things gently.
Do not read too much into my silences.
I run a ministry. I know the cost of a half-finished idea.
I will help you where I can and push you where I must.
Good administration is quiet. Bad administration is loud.
A small party learns to count carefully.
I speak for five seats and I intend to be heard.
I say what I mean. I do not always say all of it.
player_reply_en: I will read between the lines.

character_line_en: Diplomacy means standing firm in a pleasant voice.
I do not enjoy being contradicted, but I respect those who try.
Say what you came to say. I will not interrupt twice.
I would like to be convinced. Please make it worth my while.
Everything has a price, including this conversation.
player_reply_en: Then let me make it a good one.

character_line_en: I have changed my mind before. It is not as hard as people think.
I am told I am hard to read. I find that useful.
Feelings win rooms. Facts only help afterward.
I will agree with you loudly if it helps me, so be careful.
I do the reading. I expect the same from you.
Plain facts, plainly said. That is all I ask.
If I am wrong, show me. I will say so.
I take my office as a trust, not a prize.
I will hold you to what you say today.
Conscience is not a luxury in this chamber.
I care about this more than I let on.
I like to hear everyone out before I show my hand.
Friendly faces can still hold hard votes.
I am here to find a workable answer, not a winner.
Bring your plan and your doubts. I will take both.
I would rather build a bridge than win an argument.
I speak directly. I hope you do too.
The numbers on this are not subtle.
I enjoy a sharp question. I enjoy a sharp answer more.
I am not here to be gentle.
People in my district are angry, and I carry that in here.
Pick a side early. It saves everyone time.
player_reply_en: I know which one mine is.

character_line_en: The association has supported good people for years. We notice good work.
We are neighbors first and supporters second.
Come in, sit down, and tell us honestly where things stand.
I have children at home and I am watching the clock.
I just want to know if my family will be better off.
Please speak to me like a neighbor, not a politician.
My generation inherits whatever you decide tonight.
We are not impressed by speeches, only by results.
player_reply_en: Then I will aim for results.

character_line_en: Prove us wrong. We would love to be wrong about politicians.
I brought figures. I always do.
Do not tell me what people think. Show me.
I vote on what happened, not on what was promised.
I came to hear, not to heckle.
I have lived here all my life. I will know if you are straight with us.
A straight answer is all I ask.
I am here to say what others are too polite to say.
Some of us are tired of being told to be patient.
You can win me over, but you will have to work.
I have covered this house for years. Nothing surprises me anymore.
I will ask the question you hoped I would not.
Everything you say today will be quoted somewhere.
player_reply_en: Then I will say it well.

character_line_en: I am always friendly. It is part of the technique.
player_reply_en: I will keep that in mind.

character_line_en: I may ask something simple and mean something else.
Off the record is a state of mind, not a promise.
player_reply_en: Then I will stay on guard.

character_line_en: People want to feel something, not just be informed.
player_reply_en: Then I will give them both.

character_line_en: I ask what readers ask when no one is listening.
If the story moves them, it matters. Make it move.
I have my questions written down. Most of them are uncomfortable.
I keep notes on what people said last time.
A clear answer is a favor to us both.
player_reply_en: Then I will do you the favor.

character_line_en: I check every number before I use it. I will check yours.
I like precision. Please give me some.
player_reply_en: As precise as I can be.

character_line_en: If you are wrong, I will say so politely. In writing.
player_reply_en: Then I will not be wrong.

character_line_en: I am more sympathetic than I look. It is useful.
player_reply_en: I will take it as a compliment.

character_line_en: Tell me what you really feel. It makes a better story.
player_reply_en: I will tell you what I can.

character_line_en: I can be kind and still ask the hard thing.
Our members work hard and ask for little. Remember that.
We are not asking for a favor. We are asking for fairness.
player_reply_en: Fairness is what I want too.

character_line_en: I have a list of what my members need. It is short.
The cooperative does not ask for much. We ask to be heard.
We have the yields and the costs written down.
I will tell you plainly what the season has been like.
The sea gives and takes. We plan for both.
I would like to find a way that works for the boats and for you.
Our catch records are honest. I hope your promises are too.
I know every street in the neighborhood. I will know if you do not.
Small things matter to us. A broken light, a late bus.
player_reply_en: Small things matter to me too.

character_line_en: Come back and tell us what happened, whatever happens.
I am nervous, but I came anyway.
Students are tired of being talked about instead of talked to.
player_reply_en: Then I will talk to you.

character_line_en: If you mean it, say it like you mean it.
Some things are worth keeping, even when they are inconvenient.
I do not mind change. I mind careless change.
Respect what came before, and I will respect what you propose.
